subbench.objective: Realistic patterns whose feature is outside the common regex subset -- recursion, callouts, caller variables: the answer, the capability verdict (native / assisted / not-capable), and the cost of the feature, assist included.

testee.build_flags: distribution libonig.so.5 (6.9.10), direct-linked (-lonig); driver built with $CC -O2 -std=gnu11; ONIG_SYNTAX_PERL_NG / ONIG_ENCODING_ASCII (testees/onig/CLAUDE.md states the choice and its consequences); LIMITS ARM deep (lim-ceil1g, [B148] L4, unusual_set_v1.md 6.2): Oniguruma's GLOBAL setters before onig_new, outside every timed call -- match stack 33,554,432 elements (1 GiB / 32 B, Q-E), retry-in-match / retry-in-search / subexp-call-in-search 0 (unlimited), subexp-call nest level 1,000,000
testee.compile_cost_definition: interpreter (requirements 3): the one call, timed in-driver -- onig_new. No separate JIT step exists (the same execution-model class as pcre2-interp). Median of N with spread is the REPORTER's reduction.

callees_sha256.description: identity of the shared callee object (unusual_set_v1.md 3.2); ABSENT on a unity build, which recompiles callees.c
callees_sha256.source: pcrecbench/callees.py: sha256 of the ONE callees.o every native-callout driver links (fixed flags, built once)

callout_arm.description: real | pass | twin | pass-nofn: which callout arm this row is

callout_fires.description: callee calls for ONE iteration of this row's operation; absent where the engine has no counting build
callout_fires.source: the untimed COUNTING build (-DUB_COUNT), one fresh process per subject, iters 1 (unusual_set_v1.md 3.2 calibration item 1)

callout_respell.description: `(?CN)->(?{N})`: the set's PCRE spelling of a numbered callout respelled to Oniguruma's contents callout before onig_new (unusual_set_v1.md 3.2)
callout_respell.source: the adapter's site respelling, Oniguruma only

callout_spec.description: the binding spec the driver bound (site=callee,...); `none` for pass-nofn (no callout function at all)
callout_spec.source: the set's [callouts] table, member paths relative to the set

callout_views_sha256.description: the MULTISET of views the callee was shown (pos, group 1, verdict): compared across engines, differences reported
callout_views_sha256.source: the counting build's fire log, its lines SORTED then hashed

capturecount.description: lexical capturing groups in the pattern (unnamed and named together; ONIG_SYN_CAPTURE_ONLY_NAMED_GROUP under ONIG_SYNTAX_PERL_NG changes which groups the ENGINE reports at match time when the pattern mixes named and unnamed groups, never this compile-time count -- testees/onig/CLAUDE.md

deep_maxrss_kb.description: the high-water pass process's peak RSS (KiB): a LIBRARY testee's maxrss (X38 keeps match.process for process testees)
deep_maxrss_kb.source: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss of the fresh untimed process

deep_mem_bytes.description: matcher working-storage high-water in bytes, by `deep_mem_method`; never ranked across methods

lim_match_stack_elems.description: match stack cap in STACK ELEMENTS; 0 = unlimited

lim_stack_elem_bytes.description: bytes per match-stack element the deep arm's 1 GiB cap was divided by

lim_subexp_call_nest.description: subexp-call NEST LEVEL; past it Oniguruma answers silently wrong, never an error (6.3)

names.description: distinct named capture groups in the pattern

refusal_class.description: 'size-limit' for ONIGERR_PARSE_DEPTH_LIMIT_OVER (-16, a compile-time parse-nesting budget); 'syntax' for every other refusal code this adapter can parse out of the diagnostic; ABSENT (never a third value) when the diagnostic carries no parseable code -- an honest omission is not a wrong classification
refusal_class.source: the ONIGERR_* code onig_new returned on a did-not-compile outcome, bucketed by this adapter (capability_set_v1.md 5.5: 'declared ONLY by a config whose engine gives a closed, structural signal' -- Oniguruma's ONIGERR_* is exactly that)

stream_anchor.description: how each call of a call stream is bounded to its segment: `native` = the pattern's own \G at the start offset (the O(segment) pre-flight found no tail dependence), `explicit` = the engine's runtime anchoring option
stream_anchor.source: the adapter: `--anchor-explicit` passed to the driver or not
